0.long_answer: The tumor in question is gliosarcoma. It is a rare malignant brain tumor and is classified in the 2007 WHO system as a subtype of glioblastoma, the most common malignant primary brain tumor. According to the National Cancer Institute, gliosarcoma has a relative five-year survival rate of approximately 5.6%. This statistic highlights the aggressive nature of the tumor and the challenges in treatment that are associated with it.
